title: Digital Asset Loan Interest Accrual
description: Extension schema for the vwp-digital-assets-lending extension. Constrains a core calculation object of type 'digitalAssetLoanInterestAccrual': the in-kind interest accrued over an accrual window from the principal, the annual rate and the day-count basis. Located by type under calculations/.

accrualStart.description: First day of the accrual window (inclusive).

accrualEnd.description: Day after the last accrual day (exclusive), so days = accrualEnd - accrualStart.

termsFact.description: Fact id for the loan terms (rate, basis, term) extracted from the agreement.

loanId.description: Loan identifier when more than one loan or accrual window is scheduled.

currency.description: Currency the accrued fee is measured in; required when the accrual is priced.

unitPrice.description: Fair value per unit of the accrued asset as of the last accrued day (accrualEnd - 1 day).

priceFact.description: Fact id whose value is {price, date}: price = unitPrice, date = the last accrued day.

accruedFairValue.description: accruedUnits x unitPrice: the amount the executable accrual entry books.
